title: cystopus longiflorus
intro: Cystopus longiflorus, commonly known as the sea squirt, is a type of marine algae found in the coastal waters of East Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving immune function. The therapeutic actions of Cystopus longiflorus are attributed to its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and infection. The bioactive constituents of this plant include fucoidan, a sulfated polysaccharide with demonstrated anti-tumor and anti-coagulant activities.
